write.csv(combined_results$segment_results, file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_each_slope_results_20251006.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
}
if (!file.exists(file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_aapc_each_results_20251006.csv"))) {
write.csv(combined_results$overall_summary, file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_aapc_each_results_20251006.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
}
if (!file.exists(file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_bic_results_20251006.csv"))) {
write.csv(combined_results$bic_candidates, file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_bic_results_20251006.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
}
if (!file.exists(file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_change_points_results_20251006.csv"))) {
write.csv(combined_results$change_points, file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_change_points_results_20251006.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
}
if (!file.exists(file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_wald_adjacent_slopes_results_20251006.csv"))) {
write.csv(combined_results$wald_adjacent_slopes, file.path(resultsFolder, "combined_wald_adjacent_slopes_results_20251006.csv"), row.names=TRUE)
}









# Export all tables from segmented_results to CSV files

# Create results directory if it doesn't exist
results_dir <- file.path(resultsFolder, "trend_analysis")
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 1. Export change points table
if (!is.null(segmented_results$change_points) && nrow(segmented_results$change_points) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$change_points, 
            file = file.path(results_dir, "change_points.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported change points table to CSV\n")
}

# 2. Export segment results (trends for each segment)
if (!is.null(segmented_results$segment_results) && nrow(segmented_results$segment_results) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$segment_results,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "segment_trends.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported segment trends table to CSV\n")
}

# 3. Export Davies test results
if (!is.null(segmented_results$davies_test) && nrow(segmented_results$davies_test) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$davies_test,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "davies_test.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported Davies test results to CSV\n")
}

# 4. Export BIC comparison
if (!is.null(segmented_results$bic_comparison) && nrow(segmented_results$bic_comparison) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$bic_comparison,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "bic_comparison.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported BIC comparison to CSV\n")
}

# 5. Export overall trend results
if (!is.null(segmented_results$overall_results$overall_results) && 
    nrow(segmented_results$overall_results$overall_results) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$overall_results$overall_results,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "overall_trend.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported overall trend results to CSV\n")
}

# 6. Export trend data (the actual data points used for analysis)
if (!is.null(segmented_results$overall_results$trend_data) && 
    nrow(segmented_results$overall_results$trend_data) > 0) {
  write.csv(segmented_results$overall_results$trend_data,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "trend_data.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported trend data to CSV\n")
}

# Create a summary table with key results
# Combine important statistics from various tables
if (!is.null(segmented_results$davies_test) && !is.null(segmented_results$segment_results)) {
  # Number of change points
  num_changes <- nrow(segmented_results$change_points)
  
  # Davies test p-value
  davies_pvalue <- segmented_results$davies_test$P_value[1]
  
  # BIC difference (if available)
  bic_diff <- NA
  if (!is.null(segmented_results$bic_comparison) && nrow(segmented_results$bic_comparison) > 1) {
    bic_diff <- segmented_results$bic_comparison$BIC_Difference[2]
  }
  
  # Segment trends (simplified)
  segment_trends <- paste(segmented_results$segment_results$Interpretation, collapse = " → ")
  
  # Create summary table
  summary_table <- data.frame(
    Analysis_Type = "Segmented Trend Analysis",
    Count_Period = segmented_results$parameters$count_period,
    Start_Year = segmented_results$parameters$start_year,
    End_Year = segmented_results$parameters$end_year,
    Number_of_Change_Points = num_changes,
    Davies_Test_Pvalue = davies_pvalue,
    BIC_Difference = bic_diff,
    Segment_Trends = segment_trends
  )
  
  # Add any filters that were applied
  if (!is.null(segmented_results$parameters$exposure_filter)) {
    summary_table$Exposure_Filter <- segmented_results$parameters$exposure_filter
  }
  
  if (!is.null(segmented_results$parameters$gender_filter)) {
    summary_table$Gender_Filter <- segmented_results$parameters$gender_filter
  }
  
  # Export summary table
  write.csv(summary_table,
            file = file.path(results_dir, "analysis_summary.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Exported analysis summary to CSV\n")
}

cat("\nExport complete. All files saved to:", results_dir, "\n")

  pop_size_2024 = col_double()
))

phn_lookup <- read_csv(file.path(dataFolder, "phn_sa2_20250901.csv"), col_types = cols_only(
  SA2_NAME21 = col_character(),
  SA2_CODE21 = col_character(),
  PHN_CODE = col_character(),
  PHN_NAME = col_character(),
  RATIO_FROM_TO = col_double()
))

# Filter HIV data for adults and years 2001-2024
hiv_data_filtered <- hiv_data %>%
  filter(
    year_diag >= 2001,
    year_diag <= 2024,
    !is.na(phn_res),
    !is.na(year_diag),
    late_hiv_diag_flag == 1 # advanced_hiv_diag_flag cd4_50_hiv_diag_flag late_hiv_diag_flag previ_diag_overseas
  )
# Further filter to include only australian borns if needed
#hiv_data_filtered <- hiv_data_filtered %>%
#  filter(
#    au_birth == "Australia"
#  )

# Step 1: Transform population data from wide to long format
pop_sa2_long <- pop_sa2_yearly %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pop_size_"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "pop_size",
    names_prefix = "pop_size_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2001, year <= 2024)

# Step 2: Calculate PHN population for each year
phn_pop_yearly <- pop_sa2_long %>%
  inner_join(phn_lookup, by = "SA2_CODE21",relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(
    pop_alloc = pop_size * RATIO_FROM_TO
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PHN_CODE)) %>%
  group_by(PHN_CODE, PHN_NAME, year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pop = sum(pop_alloc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

yearly_totals <- phn_pop_yearly %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_australia_pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_phns = n_distinct(PHN_CODE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)


# Step 3: Calculate HIV cases by PHN and year
hiv_cases_yearly <- hiv_data_filtered %>%
  group_by(phn_res, phn_name, year_diag) %>%
  summarise(
    hiv_cases = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PHN_CODE = phn_res,
    PHN_NAME = phn_name,
    year = year_diag
  )

# Step 4: Join HIV cases with population data and calculate rates
hiv_case_rates <- phn_pop_yearly %>%
  left_join(hiv_cases_yearly, by = c("PHN_CODE", "PHN_NAME", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    hiv_cases = ifelse(is.na(hiv_cases), 0, hiv_cases),
    case_rate_per_100k = (hiv_cases / total_pop) * 100000
  ) %>%
  # Filter out any PHNs with zero population (data quality check)
  filter(total_pop > 0)

hiv_heatmap_df <- hiv_case_rates %>%
  dplyr::select(PHN_NAME, year, case_rate = case_rate_per_100k)

# Create log-transformed case rate
hiv_heatmap_df$case_rate_log <- log10(hiv_heatmap_df$case_rate + 1)

# Define breaks and colors for HIV case rates per 100k
# Adjust these based on actual data range
#scale_breaks <- c(0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 10, 15, 20)
#scale_colors <- c("#FFFFCC", "#C7E9B4", "#7FCDBB", "#41B6C4", "#1D91C0", "#225EA8", "#0C2C84", "#081D58")

scale_breaks <- c(0, 5, 10, 15,20,25)

# Transformed breaks for legend positions
log_breaks <- log10(scale_breaks + 1)


#### Gradient version normal scale####
p_timeseries_phn_2001_24_20250901_gradient <- ggplot(hiv_heatmap_df, aes(x = year, y = PHN_NAME, fill = case_rate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = scale_colors,
    breaks = scale_breaks,
    labels = scale_breaks,
    name = "Cases per\n100,000"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),

    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),

    legend.position = "right",

  ) +
  labs(
    title = "HIV Notification Rates by Primary Health Network",

    x = "Year",
